camel_example: aliyun onsmqtt ListGroupId --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key test --InstanceId 'mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000' --Tag.1.Value test
description_en: You can call the ListGroupId operation to query all Group IDs in an instance
description_zh: 调用ListGroupId查看某实例下的所有Group ID
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt list-group-id --instance-id mqtt-cn-0pp1ldu0000 --tag Value=test Key=test --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGroupId

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance for which you want to list group IDs
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的Group ID列表的实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

Data.description_en: The details of the returned group IDs
Data.description_zh: 所查询的Group ID的详细信息

CreateTime.description_en: The creation timestamp of the group ID

GroupId.description_zh: 查询到的属于该实例的Group ID

IndependentNaming.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance has an independent namespace. Valid values:

true: The instance has an independent namespace. In this case, resource names must be unique within the instance, but they can be the same as resource names in other instances.

false: The instance does not have an independent namespace. In this case, resource names must be globally unique across all instances
IndependentNaming.description_zh:
该实例是否有独立命名空间。取值如下：

true：有独立命名空间，该实例下的资源需保证命名唯一，跨实例可重名。

false：无独立命名空间，该实例下的资源需保证全局命名唯一，跨实例不可重名

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance to which the group ID belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 查询的Group ID所属实例的ID

Tags.description_en: The tags attached to the group ID

items.description_en: The tags that are associated with the group ID

UpdateTime.description_en: The timestamp of the last update for the group ID
UpdateTime.description_zh: 该Group ID的最近一次更新时间

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID for the request. This is a common parameter
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的
